mapping.sheet: Preserve measured1.6mm nominal sheet as default riser/shelf thickness; expose1.6–2mm. New base2–2.6mm.
mapping.socket: Measured4.5mm socket width becomes four4.5mm wide straight tongues, two bottom and two top. Slots are4.5+fit by sheet+fit.
mapping.fit: Source thickness allowance .100012mm measured. Proposed .15mm TOTAL new allowance, adjustable .1–.3mm; not universal.
mapping.runners: 16 original Boolean-unioned accessible side runners,.8–1.4mm wide and .4–.6mm thick; stronger than measured low runner planes.

newDesign.assembly: Two risers lower into base; shelf lowers onto top tongues; broad shoulders set heights. Bond all four fixed seats. External soft loops suspend light brushes bristles-down.
newDesign.base: span76–88mm plus14mm protected signature extension, depth38–44, .4mm shallow mat recess. Not watertight.
newDesign.packing: Custom split carrier:base/shelf stacked left, two full-height riser bays right; four accessible side runners per part,away from tongues.
newDesign.retention: Adhesive at all four fixed joints; no snap or friction-seat claim. Knot/brush retention and rack loading untested.
newDesign.differentFromPrevious: Tall brush suspension with fixed shouldered risers and pierced shelf, not a rotated-rung helix, ellipse tool or optical kit. Shared local import/export/studio infrastructure only.
newDesign.art: 14mm extension with13mm safe circular engraving zone, .4–.6mm cut,>=1.4mm backing
